Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I did before writing this plan:** I read the full chain end-to-end (no edits made) — `WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `useAuth.tsx`, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, `server.ts`, and `db/push.ts`. Summary: the wiring looks correct on paper —  - Client uses `fetch(..., { credentials: "include" })` for every watchlist call, so the session cookie should always be sent. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own auth middleware that requires a valid `arca_session` cookie
